home.summary: This archive captures 96 escape rooms across eight countries over 11 years, tracking a myriad of trips, notable players, and a collection of insightful awards. It’s a repository of our experiences and insights, charting the highs, challenges, and wins along the way.

featured.summary: This section highlights two key trips and two award-winning rooms, reflecting the favorites of our dedicated team.

jamie.intro: Jamie brings a competitive spirit and precision timing as Escaping Things' drive-to-win, frequently pushing teams toward success.

mazie.intro: Mazie is an out-of-the-box thinker who often provides unexpected solutions during team escapades.

tammy.intro: Tammy serves as the puzzle master, adept at guiding teams through the intricacies of each challenge.

tyler.intro: Tyler, the speed-runner and tactician, keeps the energy high and the decisions quick.

best-things.intro: This award spotlights the standout rooms that resonate deeply within our community.

best-things-twin-cities.intro: The best rooms in the Twin Cities according to our experiences, including highlights like The Founder's Secret.

escape-in-europe.intro: A journey through Belgium, France, and the Netherlands, moving from Amsterdam to Barcelona with lots of memorable rooms along the way.
escape-in-europe.routeSummary: Beginning in Voorburg with Molly's Game, the route winds through Utrecht, Brussels, and across Paris, culminating in a series of rooms in Barcelona.

qmsb.intro: A concentrated trip across Canada, featuring an interesting mix of rooms in Quebec City and Laval.
qmsb.routeSummary: Starting with The Dreamwalkers in Quebec City, this route leads through a range of themes in both lively cities.

1-jamies-escape-in-europe-favorites.intro: These are Jamie's top picks from the European adventure, curated from experiences across multiple cities and styles.

2-jamies-all-time-favorites.intro: A personal shortlist of rooms that have made a lasting impression on Jamie over the years.

3-top-twin-cities-rooms.intro: A collection of the top rooms to try in the Twin Cities, shaped by our team's favorite escapes.
